checks.title: Solution-agnostic business needs
checks.detail: 1/5 — Requirements prescribe interface elements and presentation rather than business capabilities or outcomes.
evidence: ✔ The dashboard shows a fast, intuitive real-time map of all kaiju and sensors.
✔ A Deploy button dispatches units automatically to the selected kaiju.
✔ The header shows the Clipzilla mascot, which changes expression as the threat rises.
checks.guidance: Aim for: Every requirement states a business capability or outcome only.

checks.title: Business goal quality
checks.detail: 1/5 — The sole goal is vague and has no defined KPI, deadline, accountable measurement owner, or plan to establish the missing baseline and target.
evidence: ✔ BG-001: Make the response better and faster.
checks.guidance: Aim for: Goals are SMART, or missing values carry an explicit, owned plan to measure them.

checks.title: Atomic, testable requirements
checks.detail: 1/5 — Requirements combine behaviors and subjective qualities without measurable definitions. Acceptance criteria do not resolve ambiguity about speed, usability, robustness, or successful operation.
evidence: ✔ The dashboard shows a fast, intuitive real-time map of all kaiju and sensors.
✔ The screen is user-friendly and robust.
✔ The map works well. Covers: FR-001.
checks.guidance: Aim for: Requirements are atomic, unambiguous, and directly verifiable.

checks.title: Traceability to evidence
checks.detail: 1/5 — No requirements or rules cite stakeholder evidence or recorded decisions. The traceability matrix links only two requirements to acceptance criteria, which does not establish their business justification.
evidence: ✔ * **BR-001**: The system decides the threat level automatically.
✔ | FR-004 | A single confidence percentage summarizes all sensor data. | Must | | |
checks.guidance: Aim for: All requirements trace to evidence or recorded decisions.

checks.title: Scope discipline
checks.detail: 1/5 — Every functional requirement is Must without supporting prioritization evidence. No exclusions, rationale, or reconsideration points are recorded, and the sponsor's demo preference is not separated from responder needs.
evidence: ✔ | FR-003 | The header shows the Clipzilla mascot, which changes expression as the threat rises. | Must | | BG-001 |
✔ steering group sees a slick demo.
checks.guidance: Aim for: Priorities follow evidence; exclusions have reasons and reconsideration points.

checks.title: Risks, assumptions, and open questions
checks.detail: 1/5 — The document asserts that there are no risks or open questions despite unspecified performance, security, threat assessment, and dispatch behavior. It provides no evidence-quality assessment, owners, assumptions, or mitigations.
evidence: ✔ The system should be fast and secure.
checks.guidance: Aim for: Specific, owned, and tied to evidence strength with mitigations.
